description: This file contains utility functions and scripts for system upgrade processes in OpenWRT, including file installation, hook execution, device identification, partition handling, and firmware flashing.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by reading image data and writing to MTD partition, with optional backup.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to indicate an upgrade process.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to RAM root, handling symbolic links.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs executable files, including their dependencies.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts user for a yes/no answer with default.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem type.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads image data from a source, auto-detecting compression.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Reads image data with dd, with verbose output.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads magic word from image.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads long magic value from image.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Reads GPT magic from image.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Reads VFAT magic from image.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Reads FAT32 magic from image.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies image type based on magic value.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks for EFI partition magic.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks for FAT or FAT32 partition magic.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Determines and exports the boot device based on kernel command line.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports partition device based on major/minor numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts little-endian 32-bit hex to CPU order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table from device or file.
